blends.name: Nifty VIP Coin
blends.desc:
Did you collect all 3 prelaunch promo NFTs? Blend them here to receive the Nifty VIP Coin!

The Nifty VIP Coin is like a membership token that gives you VIP access to our artists and airdrops from new artists as they join the collective. Random one-offs, early access to new features, and various other to-be-announced features will be included. 

Check out the [artists](https://niftyartcollective.com/artists) page to see some of the artists we're working with, with many more to come.
